title: Location Presence Failure Rate
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=location:visit
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(presence_state,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by city
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often location presence records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each city.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize presence_state values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per city.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It reveals which parts of your location presence data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
